name: fictional-note-evidence-ledger
description: Prepare a traceable ledger of factual claims from supplied fictional notes, with missing data preserved as unknown.
outcome: Deliver a structured note-to-claim ledger that attributes each claim to its actual supplied source and marks unsupported claims UNKNOWN.
trigger: Use for an authorized request to organize and assess notes explicitly provided in this conversation.
non_trigger: Do not activate for open-web research, inaccessible private records, unsupported claims, or requests to send the report.
inputs: Only the current user's supplied fictional notes and requested report scope, with no network fetches or implied access.
verification: Every claimed fact must cite a supplied note identifier; missing evidence and contradictions are visible rather than invented.
failure_handling: When evidence is missing, label it UNKNOWN and request only the necessary note; do not infer a plausible source.

steps.title: Attribute each claim
steps.instructions: Assign each supplied note a stable local identifier and associate each factual claim with one or more actual supporting note IDs. Flag unsupported claims and conflicting claims as UNKNOWN rather than inventing a citation.
steps.output: Produce a claim ledger with supporting source identifiers, unresolved conflicts, and visible UNKNOWN fields.
